camera.question: Answer R4 and T8 in coordinator/facts.md for register entry d18. With full-sensor Mono8 in free run and autostream 0: (1) While stopped, after features/bool_set AcquisitionFrameRateEnable true, what do features/access_mode_get and features/float_info_get report for AcquisitionFrameRate? (2) Does features/float_set AcquisitionFrameRate 30.0 succeed, and what does features/float_get read back? (3) With that setting, what rate does 'timeout 20 ros2 topic hz /vimbax_camera/image_raw' report after stream_start? Report the last rate, the window size, the interval minimum and maximum, and whether the rate is within 29 to 31 Hz. Rules: First call stream_stop. Then read PixelFormat with features/enum_get, Width and Height with features/int_get, AcquisitionFrameRateEnable with features/bool_get, and AcquisitionFrameRate with features/float_get. If PixelFormat is not Mono8 or the size is not 1296 x 1032, report the values and do not write or stream. Write only AcquisitionFrameRateEnable and AcquisitionFrameRate, and only while stopped. Do not call the status service. If AcquisitionFrameRate stays read only or 30.0 is outside its range, record that, skip the stream, and restore. Start ros2 topic hz before stream_start. Call stream_stop before any restore. To restore, while stopped and with the enable still true, write AcquisitionFrameRate back to the value that you read first. Then write AcquisitionFrameRateEnable back to the value that you read first. Read both back. If a write fails, record the error code and continue the restore.
